title: Miwok - Wikipedia
text: For thousands of years, the Miwok people lived throughout Northern and Central California – spread over a hundred villages along the San Joaquin and Sacramento Rivers and north of the San Francisco Bay area, east into the foothills of the Sierra Nevada.

title: Miwok Music Project - Sound Orchard
text: The Miwok Music Project explores the influence of music created by the indigenous people of Northern California through community singing, language instruction, song recording and documentation, and the creation of new music rooted in Miwok culture.

title: Ione Band of Miwok Indians – Ione Band of Miwok Indians Tribe
text: The Ione Band of Miwok Indians is comprised of Northern Sierra Miwok and Nisenan peoples. For thousands of years, our people have lived on the lands that today make up Amador County and the surrounding area.

title: Miwok Language and the Miwok Indian Tribe (Miwuk, Miwoc ...
text: There are seven dialects of Miwok which are so distinct from one another that most linguists consider them to be multiple languages, but since three of them are no longer spoken and the other four are spoken by fewer than a dozen elders apiece, they are usually discussed together.
